capabilities: Browse media in a grid with folder, type, tag, and search filters
Preview files full screen with zoom, playback, and a details panel
Edit filenames, tags, and descriptions in bulk
Group files into named collections with multiple memberships
Import media into a chosen folder and save copies to the device
disambiguation: Not a digital-garden or publishing tool; it only browses and manages media files already in the vault or a connected Immich library.
extras: Plugin ID is vault-gallery; renamed from Vault Gallery to Media Gallery to Media Hub (0.1.2, 0.1.3). Tags, descriptions, and collections live in .obsidian/plugins/vault-gallery/data.json, not in note properties or EXIF, so they do not appear in Obsidian's native tag search and are not merged across simultaneous edits on multiple devices. Desktop exports are limited to 512 MB per selection; Android and iOS saving paths still need physical-device verification. Immich support requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; the local gallery requires 1.7.2+. No transcoder, external service, or AI categorization. GPL-3.0-only, with a Buy Me a Coffee link in the manifest.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse or manage non-note media files across the vault, so images, videos, audio, and PDFs can only be found by file path or note links.
summary: Media library plugin that browses vault images, GIFs, videos, audio, and PDFs in a filterable gallery with tags, collections, previews, and export.
